Package businesslogic

Class ProductBL

java.lang.Object
businesslogic.ProductBL
public class ProductBL extends Object
Business Logic Layer class for managing Product entities. Serves as the processing layer between the presentation views and the data access subsystem, handling validation and execution logic for items within the inventory catalog. * @author Yasmina
